title: Transfer day shakeout: 15min flat, Bansko on arrival
terrain: flat, Bansko, wherever legs land after the drive
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 15min flat easy jog after arriving in Bansko, ideally before registration if legs allow, otherwise after. Priority is loosening up from the ~160km drive, not exercise - if it turns into a scout of the finish area, good, but that's a bonus not the point.
GYM: none.
FUEL: normal meals, hydrate through the drive (car AC dries you out), no alcohol.
STOP RULE: anything but completely clean legs, cut it to a walk.
LOGISTICS: registration and mandatory medical check 13:00-20:00 in Bansko.
WHY: last movement before the race. Zero training value, purely circulation plus a logistics dry run - parking, walk to registration, where the start line is.
